sources.quote: 外形寸法 約325×98×274mm（幅×高さ×奥行き）（突起物含まず）
入出力 USB 2.0 ○ (x4) Memory Stick/SD/CompactFlash－ ○ 通信 Ethernet ○ (x1 / 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T)
HDMI出力端子 － ○ (x1 / HDMI NextGen) AVマルチ出力端子 ○ (x1) 光デジタル出力端子 ○ (x1)
次世代コンピュータエン タテインメントシステム「プレイステーション ３」

notes: Sony's 2006-05-08 Japanese launch release (PDF, macOS PDFKit) prints one table with a 20 GB and a 60 GB column; the 60 GB column is CECH-A00, which Sony's own PS3 model-differences page (playstation.com/ja-jp, source 1) names: CECH-A00, HDD 60GB, メディアスロット あり, USB端子 4個, 重さ 約5kg. Dimensions are common to both columns; axes labelled (幅×高さ×奥行き): width 325, height 98, depth 274, 突起物含まず (excluding projections), so the dimension source covers dimensions_mm. 5 kg recorded as 5000 g.

ports = the 60 GB column's 入出力, 通信 and AV出力 rows (the second source covers the three AV items). Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. The 60 GB column has the Memory Stick/SD/CompactFlash card slots; SD is filed as sd_card with count null (Sony does not count the slot), and Memory Stick and CompactFlash have no §3 kind. Sony's input/output row does not list the AC inlet, so ports has no power_in item; that absence is Sony's table, not a statement that the console has no inlet. features.power_inlet stays null.

Cross-check, not used as a value: Sony's 2007-02-23 European specification (CECHC02/03/04/08, the same 60 GB chassis) prints 'Approximately 325mm (W) x 98mm (H) x 274mm (D)', '(excluding maximum projecting part)' and 'Approximately 5 kg', with 4 x USB, Memory Stick, SD and CF slots, Ethernet, HDMI, AV MULTI and optical out.

media: Sony's tables name the BD/DVD/CD drive but not how the disc loads; media stays uncovered. released = the Japanese date the launch release announces (NA and EU: 2006-11-17 in the same release; Europe later moved to 2007-03-23).
external_ids: Wikidata Q10683 ('video game console developed Sony Interactive Entertainment', the platform, whose launch model this is); igdb_platform 'ps3' is Wikidata P5795 on that item.
